blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Poor and near-poor households in Central Visayas covered by the government’s Uplift program can receive two monthly installments of cash assistance on Thursday, November 19, through their verified GCash accounts. The Department of Social Welfare and Development in Central Visayas (DSWD-7) will facilitate the third and fourth tranches of the Unified Package for Livelihood, Industry, Food, and Transport (Uplift) assistance for Group 2 beneficiaries. The digital Uplift payout will cover beneficiaries with registered and verified GCash accounts, according to the agency’s announcement.
